title: Route non-subject/non-landscape and blurry photos to review
description: in process_images(), additionally classify non-blurry photos with classify_subject_or_landscape(img_path): route 'unclear' to REVIEW_DIR with status UNCLEAR, and 'subject'/'landscape' to target_dir with that category uppercased as status
acceptance_criteria: Blurry images still route to REVIEW_DIR with status 'BLURRY'
Non-blurry images are classified via classify_subject_or_landscape(img_path)
Images classified 'unclear' route to REVIEW_DIR with status 'UNCLEAR'
Images classified 'subject' or 'landscape' route to target_dir with status 'SUBJECT' or 'LANDSCAPE'
The rest of the loop (collision handling, shutil.move, print, processed_count) is unchanged and still works with the target_base/status variables
